RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: Not estimable from the information provided

An all-women panel is not, by itself, evidence of sex bias. Your qualifications justify seeking an explanation, but publication counts and PhD status may not capture teaching quality, subject fit, or relevant industry experience.

Follow up now requesting the selection criteria, their weighting, feedback on your assessment, and the expected response timeline. If a completed PhD was mandatory, specifically ask how that requirement was applied.

Raise sex discrimination if concrete evidence emerges—such as sex-related remarks or inconsistent application of criteria—not simply because of the panel’s composition. Check local complaint deadlines promptly; waiting for feedback may not pause them. A numerical probability here would be invented.
